rows.coder_note: Step 4 (rules D, I1): the abstract gives 'FinnGen Consortium' with case and control counts only (264 cases, 3,72,273 controls); no release number, accession or citation, and the outcome side has FinnGen rows, so C2 does not apply.

Step 4 (rules D, I1): 'the study by Sakaue et al' with counts only (821 cases, 4,84,422 controls); the passage lists no reference entry, no accession and no attribute separating the three Sakaue 2021 outcome rows.

Step 4: reference 23 (Sun 2023, doi 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6) is the source of four UKB-PPP rows and rule E needs a separating attribute; the only attribute given, 54,219 UKB participants, equals no row's sample size (34557, 17806, 52363, 2518), so no row is picked and no row is contradicted. p002 concerns the AstraZeneca PheWAS portal, not the pQTL data.
